tools.name: get_my_info
tools.description: Returns the current user's profile, managed projects, assigned work items, and workload summary.
notes: Use when the user asks 'what am I working on?', 'show my tasks', 'what projects do I manage?'.

tools.name: find_users
tools.description: Find users by ID list, email list, or project involvement.
notes: Use to resolve a user UUID from a name/email before any assignment operation.
Output: [{"user_id": "uuid", "name": "...", "email": "..."}]

tools.name: find_projects
tools.description: Find projects by partial name, manager, or status.
notes: Use to resolve a project UUID from a name before any project operation.
Statuses: OPEN, CLOSE.
Output: [{"project_id": "uuid", "title": "...", "status": "...", "managed_by": "uuid"}]

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project.
notes: managed_by and created_by: use current user's UUID unless told otherwise.
status defaults to OPEN.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update project title, description, or status.
notes: All fields except user_id and project_id are optional.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Soft-delete a project.

tools.name: find_tasks
tools.description: Find work items using flexible filters.
notes: item_types: TASK, STORY.
statuses: TODO, IN_PROGRESS, CODE_COMPLETE, DEPLOYED_ON_STAGE, DONE.
Output: [{"work_item_id": "uuid", "title": "...", "status": "...", "item_type": "..."}]

tools.name: create_work_item
tools.description: Create a new work item (task or story) in a project.
notes: Resolve project_id and assigned_to via find_projects / find_users first if not known.
Use current user UUID for assigned_by and created_by.

tools.name: update_work_item
tools.description: Update any combination of fields on a work item.

tools.name: reassign_work_item
tools.description: Reassign a work item to a new user.
notes: Use this instead of update_work_item when the only change is reassignment, for clarity.

tools.name: bulk_update_status
tools.description: Change the status of multiple work items in one call.
notes: Use when the user asks to mark several tasks done/in-progress at once.

tools.name: link_work_items
tools.description: Link a work item to another (parent/dependency relationship).

tools.name: move_work_item
tools.description: Move a work item to a different project.

tools.name: delete_work_item
tools.description: Soft-delete a work item.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List all comments on a work item.
notes: Resolve work_item_id via find_tasks first if not known.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment or threaded reply to a work item.
notes: comment_reply_id is optional; provide to reply to an existing comment.
Use current user UUID for created_by.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Soft-delete a comment.

tools.name: get_project_summary
tools.description: Returns a project's total work items broken down by status, type, assignee, and overdue count.
notes: Use when the user asks 'how's project X going?' or 'give me a sprint summary'.

tools.name: get_user_workload
tools.description: Returns a user's active work items and a status breakdown. project_id is optional to scope it.
notes: Use when asked 'what is Alice working on?' or 'is someone overloaded?'.

tools.name: get_overdue_items
tools.description: Returns all work items past their end date that are not yet DONE. Both filters are optional.
notes: Use when asked 'what's overdue?' or 'show late tasks'.
